يستوطأ (form X)
# يُسْتَوْطَأُ (yustawṭaʔu) /jus.taw.tˤa.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# يُسْتَوْطَأَ (yustawṭaʔa) /jus.taw.tˤa.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# يُسْتَوْطَأْ (yustawṭaʔ) /jus.taw.tˤaʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ
